Name: Christmas_Miller_Feast_Line
$Comment: Tomas's Christmas line in his Harvest Feast conversation. Christmas starts while the feast's last
days still run, and while the feast runs Tomas stands at his feast spot speaking his feast
conversation (NpcPlacements/Harvest_Feast_Miller_Temple.json takes its feast entry first). This line
lets a player reach his Christmas stall from the first day of Christmas all the same, and its second
line opens his quest list, where his Christmas quests (Christmas Cookies, christmas_gingerbread_cookies,
and his daily, Daily Baking, christmas_daily_baking) are offered, carried and handed in, since they are
bound to the id he keeps in both seasons (Harvest_Feast_Miller). Once the feast is over he speaks his
Christmas conversation (Dialogues/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Miller.json), which offers the stall and
the quests itself, and the feast conversation is no longer reached.
Dialogues.Ids names his feast conversation alone, since each villager's lines open that villager's
own stall and quests (Christmas_Weaver_Feast_Line and Christmas_Shepherd_Feast_Line do the same for
Elsie and Bram). They land on the screens the conversation opens on, after a screen's own lines and
before the goodbye group, so goodbye stays last. Season offers them only while Christmas runs; to take
them out, set Enabled false in a file of the same name. The lines pay nothing themselves.
